top_signals.title: Factory backlogs build as freight and steel costs climb
top_signals.summary:
Unfilled factory orders rose to $1.61 trillion in August while shipments stalled, and the steel, freight and diesel needed to work them off cost more in September.

The post Factory backlogs build as freight and steel costs climb appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
